title: Search and filter patients
summary: Search by name, email or ID; filter by registration date, debtors or active only; open the record.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Search
steps.details: Type part of the name, the email or the ID.

steps.title: Filters
steps.details: Registration period (all, today, this week, this month) and status: debtors only or active only.

steps.title: By registration date
steps.details: «This month» shows the patients registered this month; «All» removes the date filter.

steps.title: Debtors only
steps.details: Patients with an outstanding balance; the list shows each one's debt.

steps.title: Open the record
steps.details: Tap a patient to see their full record on the right.
